0075b2400459.name: Corrosive Filth
0075b2400459.plain: Attacks made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit get 1 added to their Damage characteristic.

012b4a39d3e6.name: Nurglings' claws and teeth
012b4a39d3e6.plain: Once this model has made its close combat attacks, its mount can attack too: make D6 more attacks with this profile. For those attacks, you can re-roll any wound roll of 1 that you make.

0200d279b3c8.name: Bilious Blood-rush

021ce805f1b6.name: Injector pistol
021ce805f1b6.plain: Plague Weapon. Whenever an attack with this weapon targets an INFANTRY, CAVALRY or BEASTS unit and successfully wounds, it inflicts D3 mortal wounds on top of any normal damage.

04fea803e14d.name: Unleash the Horde
04fea803e14d.plain: During your Movement phase when one of your TERMINUS EST ASSAULT FORCE POXWALKERS units is picked to move, or during the Fight phase when one is picked to fight: for the rest of the turn, every TERMINUS EST ASSAULT FORCE POXWALKER model you have gets its Move characteristic increased by 3", and whenever those models Pile in, they may go 3" further.

056a538db8f8.name: Disgusting Force

0af03949b878.name: Sickly Corrosion
0af03949b878.plain: During your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a plague weapon attack by one of your DEATH GUARD models scores a hit on an enemy unit: for the rest of the turn, whenever a DEATH GUARD model attacks that enemy unit, any wound roll of 1 is re-rolled.

0e99310b40ed.name: Tocsin of Misery (Aura)
0e99310b40ed.plain: Aura: subtract 1 from Combat Attrition tests taken for enemy units while they are within 6" of this model.

0f418a769152.name: Sevenfold Blessings
0f418a769152.plain:
Before the battle, while you muster your army, this Stratagem lets you pick a WRETCHED PSYKER model of yours.
- It knows one more psychic power from the discipline it chose.
- You may re-roll one of its Psychic tests per Psychic phase.

1148128537cd.name: Mutoid Infestation
1148128537cd.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, choose a destroyed MUTOID VERMIN unit of yours. Place it back on the battlefield wholly within 12" of one of your GELLERPOX INFECTED units and over 9" away from every enemy model.

12e001c80a46.name: Plagueburst Mortar
12e001c80a46.plain: Blast. Plague Weapon. This weapon can target units the bearer can't see.

134d0bd8bdac.name: Sevenfold Blessings
134d0bd8bdac.plain:
Before the battle, while you muster your army, this Stratagem lets you pick a WRETCHED PSYKER model of yours.
- It knows one more psychic power from the discipline it chose.
- You may re-roll one of its Psychic tests per Psychic phase.
This Stratagem can be used only once.

14d9c58947f0.name: Unending Horde
14d9c58947f0.plain: Whenever a model in this unit is about to lose a wound, roll a D6. On a 6, that model keeps the wound.

16db027dfb69.name: Infernal Regeneration
16db027dfb69.plain: In your Command phase, this model gets back 1 lost wound.

1b9bf3eee4c2.name: Mindless Horde
1b9bf3eee4c2.plain: This unit can't perform actions, except the Spread the Sickness action.

1bb55d28ae51.name: Plague Wind
1bb55d28ae51.plain: Witchfire: if manifested, choose an enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see. Roll a D6 for each of that unit's models; each 6 rolled inflicts 1 mortal wound on the unit. If the Psychic test result was 9+, each 5+ rolled inflicts 1 mortal wound instead.

1c6173496198.name: Diseased Effluents
1c6173496198.plain: In your Command phase, pick one DEATH GUARD CHARACTER model from your army (not a DAEMON model) and one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it. Your model suffers 1 mortal wound, then you roll one D6. On a 2+, the enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds, or D3 mortal wounds instead if it has the CHARACTER keyword (unless it is a VEHICLE unit).

1d428251f8c3.name: Seeded Growths
1d428251f8c3.plain: During deployment, when you set this model up, it can go anywhere on the battlefield that is over 12" from the enemy deployment zone and from all enemy models. After a Miasmic Malignifier has been placed on the battlefield, you may then place one Pox Furnace terrain feature wholly within 6" of it, again over 12" from the enemy deployment zone and from all enemy models.

1ee10143da04.name: Daemonic Gluttony
1ee10143da04.plain: During the Fight phase, once a DEATH GUARD DAEMON ENGINE model of yours is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, whenever one of its attacks destroys an enemy model, the DAEMON ENGINE model regains 1 lost wound, but it can regain no more than 3 wounds per phase this way.

1f0908b22ee6.name: Lord of Nurgle
1f0908b22ee6.plain: Your Nurgle <Legion> units within 6" of this model can re-roll all hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

2037c6c885bc.name: Plague Brewers
2037c6c885bc.plain: During your Shooting phase, once a MORTARION'S CHOSEN SONS unit of yours is picked to shoot: any plague belchers, plaguespurt gauntlets and plague spewers its models carry have their Damage characteristic set to 2 for the rest of the phase.

21e9e4812d37.name: Master of the Dead
21e9e4812d37.plain: Whenever this model successfully manifests a psychic power, pick one friendly POXWALKERS unit within 6". Up to D3 destroyed models are returned to that unit.

2685f3b2f6c0.name: Cloud of Flies
2685f3b2f6c0.plain: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, pick a BUBONIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit of yours. For the rest of the phase, an enemy model that shoots can't target your unit (until that shooting is resolved) unless your unit is the closest eligible target or within 12" of that shooter. Also for the rest of the phase, your unit loses the Bodyguard ability if it has it. Cost: 4CP if the unit has the TERMINATOR keyword, otherwise 2CP.

27761b265a80.name: Herald of Nurgle
27761b265a80.plain: Normally a Detachment can't contain units from two different plague companies, but this model can still be part of any Death Guard Detachment, and it doesn't stop other units in that Detachment carrying a Plague Company Contagion. This model may carry a Plague Company Contagion itself only when it belongs to a Harbingers Detachment.

2b14c7be9fbc.name: Blight Bombardment
2b14c7be9fbc.plain: Once per battle, during your Command phase, if your DEATH GUARD WARLORD is on the battlefield: put a marker on any point of the battlefield. When your next Command phase starts, roll a D6 for each unit within 6" of that marker's centre; add 1 to the result for an INFANTRY unit and subtract 1 for a CHARACTER. A 2-6 means that unit takes D3 mortal wounds, and a 7+ means it takes D6 mortal wounds. The marker is then removed. Cost: 2CP if your WARLORD has the LORD OF VIRULENCE keyword, otherwise 3CP.

2b41198ac834.name: Eater Plague (Contagion)
2b41198ac834.plain: When a friendly WRETCHED model attacks an enemy unit that is within this unit's Contagion Range, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

2bcab3f7f783.name: Haze of Corruption
2bcab3f7f783.plain: During the Fight phase, once a DEATH GUARD CORE unit of yours is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, if an attack by one of its models destroys an enemy model, the attack's excess damage isn't lost. Instead it carries over to another model in that enemy model's unit, which gets no saving throw against it. Keep going until no excess damage remains.

2c7d112b8864.name: Champion of Disease
2c7d112b8864.plain:
Before the battle, while mustering your army: pick one BUBONIC ASTARTES model from your army with the word 'Champion' in its profile, and give it one of these Relics of Decay (it must be a Relic that model could have): Reaper of Glorious Entropy, Plague Skull of Glothila, Plaguebringer or Suppurating Plate.

Every Relic in your army must be unique, and this Stratagem can't give one model two Relics. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

2cd57f0acb1d.name: Putrescent Vitality
2cd57f0acb1d.plain: Blessing: if manifested, choose a friendly DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Its models get 1 added to their Strength and Toughness characteristics until your next Psychic phase starts.

2db073d87043.name: Putrid Detonation
2db073d87043.plain: In any phase, once a DEATH GUARD VEHICLE model of yours is destroyed: skip the roll to see if it explodes, as it explodes automatically. Cost: 1CP if that model's Wounds characteristic is 9 or less, otherwise 2CP.

2e0beef60370.name: Trench Fighters
2e0beef60370.plain: During the Fight phase, once a DEATH GUARD PLAGUE MARINES unit of yours is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, whenever one of its models with any plague knives fights, it gets 1 bonus attack with one of those plague knives.

2fb46800e505.name: Sanguous Flux (Contagion)
2fb46800e505.plain: Enemy units within this unit's Contagion Range get 1 subtracted from their models' Leadership characteristic and from Combat Attrition tests taken for them.

302bc7a634bd.name: Putrescent Fog (Aura)
302bc7a634bd.plain: Aura: while one of your DEATH GUARD INFANTRY units is wholly within 6" of this model, it gets the benefits of Light Cover. If it was already getting the benefits of Light Cover, then subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made against that unit.

31455ca5576f.name: Vermid Whispers
31455ca5576f.plain: During your Shooting phase when a DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR unit of yours is picked to shoot, or during the Fight phase when one is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, its models' attacks get 1 added to their hit rolls.

32d3992517af.name: Lord of the Death Guard (Aura)
32d3992517af.plain: Aura: while one of your DEATH GUARD CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

341dd2ac4105.name: Death Guard Sorcerer in Terminator Armour
341dd2ac4105.plain: This model knows Smite and two psychic powers from the Contagion discipline.

34fdb5584319.name: Harbinger of Death (Aura)
34fdb5584319.plain: Aura: if an enemy model with Leadership 7 or less is within 3" of this WARLORD, its unit can't use Objective Secured or similar abilities, or perform actions. Also, while one or more enemy models are within range of this aura, this WARLORD's Attacks characteristic goes up by 1.

356c6089c74c.name: Plentiful Pestilence
356c6089c74c.plain: If the bearer would lose a wound, roll a D6 each time; on a 5+, the bearer keeps that wound.

37bbef97e148.name: Deadly Pathogens
37bbef97e148.plain: Whenever you give a model a Deadly Pathogen, choose one of its plague weapons to upgrade; it can't be a Grenade weapon or a Relic. On top of the Deadly Pathogen's own effects, add 1 to that weapon's Strength characteristic. The Power Rating of the model's unit goes up by 1.

39d9d830f401.name: Revoltingly Resilient
39d9d830f401.plain: Roll a D6 each time this WARLORD would lose a wound; on a 5+, it keeps that wound.

3a0f188dbb56.name: Dark Cravings
3a0f188dbb56.plain: During your opponent's Charge phase, choose a FOETID BLOAT-DRONE unit of yours. For the rest of the phase, if any enemy units are within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of it, it may perform Heroic Interventions like a CHARACTER, and when it does so it may move up to 6" rather than 3". Every other Heroic Intervention rule still applies.

3bc87f8f88a9.name: Mortarion
3bc87f8f88a9.plain: This model knows Smite and 3 psychic powers from the Contagion discipline.

4101d18e771a.name: Gift of Contagion
4101d18e771a.plain: Malediction: if manifested, choose an enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, that unit's models have their Strength characteristic reduced by 1. If the Psychic test result was 8+, reduce both their Strength and Attacks characteristics by 1 instead.

438f27a462a7.name: Twisted Blessings
438f27a462a7.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, pick a HULLBREAKERS model from your army. It gets back one lost wound.

43a05b6841d8.name: Daemon Primarch
43a05b6841d8.plain: In a Battle-forged army, this model has to be your army's WARLORD. When several models in your army have a rule like this, one of them has to be your WARLORD.

44528c9eeab0.name: Host of Plagues
44528c9eeab0.plain: When the first battle round starts, choose one Warlord Trait from this list: Shamblerot, Ferric Blight, Gloaming Bloat, Eater Plague, Sanguous Flux, Nurgle's Fruit or The Droning. It can't be one that another model in your army already has. For the rest of the battle this model has the chosen trait as well as any others it has, even when it isn't your WARLORD.

45665dc14ccb.name: Gloaming Bloat (Contagion)
45665dc14ccb.plain: Enemy units within this unit's Contagion Range can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend. Also, hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks by their models can't be re-rolled.

4840816b3222.name: Tainted Narthecium (Aura)
4840816b3222.plain: Aura: if a model in one of your BUBONIC ASTARTES INFANTRY units within 3" of this model would lose a wound, roll a D6 each time; on a 6, the model keeps that wound.

49f778144bc0.name: Explodes
49f778144bc0.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before it is removed and before any embarked models get out. On a 6, it blows up: every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

4bf8ecc19723.name: Chimes of contagion
4bf8ecc19723.plain: Each Contagion ability the bearer's unit has gets 3" added to its Contagion Range, up to a maximum of 12".

4d3161b4798a.name: Creeping Blight
4d3161b4798a.plain: During the Fight phase, once a DEATH GUARD unit of yours is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, when one of its models attacks with a plague weapon and rolls an unmodified 6 to wound, that attack's Armour Penetration becomes -4.

4d49b29f4197.name: Plague Skull of Glothila
4d49b29f4197.plain: Once per battle, when your Movement phase ends, the bearer may use this Enhancement. If it does, choose an enemy unit within 6" of the bearer and roll seven D6s. Each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that unit, but a unit with the CHARACTER keyword can take no more than 3 mortal wounds this way.

4f560009ca58.name: Callous Disregard
4f560009ca58.plain:
In your Shooting phase, choose a BUBONIC ASTARTES TERMINUS EST ASSAULT FORCE unit of yours that is eligible to shoot.
- For the rest of the turn, its models may target enemy units that are in Engagement Range of your own POXWALKERS or PLAGUE FOLLOWERS units.
- When one of its models attacks an enemy unit that is in Engagement Range of one of your POXWALKERS or PLAGUE FOLLOWERS units, subtract 1 from the hit roll; a failed hit roll means the attack hits that POXWALKERS or PLAGUE FOLLOWERS unit instead.

4f5d963a6ae5.name: Shamblerot (Contagion)
4f5d963a6ae5.plain: When your opponent's Movement phase starts, roll one D6 for each enemy unit (other than a VEHICLE unit) within this unit's Contagion Range. Subtract 1 from the roll if that unit is a CHARACTER unit. On a 4+ it suffers 1 mortal wound, or D3 mortal wounds if the roll is a 6.

53d82eaacf3e.name: Eruption of Filth
53d82eaacf3e.plain: In any phase, once a DEATH GUARD CHARACTER model of yours is destroyed, you may use this Stratagem rather than any other rules that trigger when a model is destroyed (for example, Putrid Explosion). Before that model is removed from play, roll a D6 for every other unit within 3", apart from NURGLE units: a 2-5 means that unit takes 1 mortal wound, and a 6 means it takes D3 mortal wounds.

56c22e7b2365.name: Hulking Physique
56c22e7b2365.plain: This WARLORD gets 1 added to its Wounds characteristic, and an unmodified wound roll of 1-3 always fails for attacks made against it. That holds whatever abilities the attacking model or its weapon may have.

56d98d047055.name: Fire Fever
56d98d047055.plain: During your Shooting phase, once a DEATH GUARD HELBRUTE model of yours is picked to shoot: for the rest of the phase, it may only target a single eligible enemy unit, and every attack it makes gets 1 added to its hit roll and 1 added to its wound roll.

56e816480ffe.name: The Dead Walk Again
56e816480ffe.plain: During your Command phase, choose a POXWALKERS unit of yours and roll seven D6s. Every 3+ returns one of its destroyed models to it with 1 wound left. Those returned models may be placed within Engagement Range of enemy units, as long as those enemy units are already in Engagement Range of the POXWALKERS unit. A unit can be chosen for this Stratagem only once per battle.

578eae3b75e2.name: The Barbaran Plate
578eae3b75e2.plain: Mortarion has an invulnerable save of 4+.

58acbbdb8c32.name: Acidic Malady
58acbbdb8c32.plain: This weapon's Armour Penetration characteristic is improved by 1.

5c6cc45c049d.name: Silence - Reaping scythe
5c6cc45c049d.plain: Plague Weapon. For each attack made with this weapon profile, make 3 hit rolls rather than 1.

5ca223557e98.name: Foul Smokescreen
5ca223557e98.plain: During your opponent's Shooting phase, once a DEATH GUARD SMOKESCREEN unit of yours is picked as an attack's target: for the rest of the phase, attacks against that unit have 1 subtracted from their hit rolls.

61fb4e919160.name: Bodyguard (Aura)
61fb4e919160.plain: Aura: if one of your <PLAGUE COMPANY> CHARACTER units with a Wounds characteristic no higher than 9 is within 3" of this unit, that CHARACTER unit may use the Look Out, Sir rule even when this unit has less than 3 models.

65139263cf8c.name: Accelerated Entropy
65139263cf8c.plain: Witchfire: if manifested, pick one enemy model within 12" of this PSYKER that it can see. You and your opponent each roll one D6 and add the Toughness characteristic of your own model. If your total beats your opponent's, that enemy model suffers 3 mortal wounds. If your total is double your opponent's or more, that model's unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

670bd9ef3bec.name: Ferric Miasma
670bd9ef3bec.plain: During your opponent's Charge phase, once an INEXORABLE unit of yours is picked as a charge target: for the rest of the phase, any unit declaring a charge against that INEXORABLE unit subtracts 2 from its charge rolls, but they can't go below 1 this way.

6860f29060f4.name: Vector of Disease
6860f29060f4.plain: Each Contagion ability this model has gets 3" added to its Contagion range, up to a maximum of 12".

68d8fa556ae3.name: Putrid Explosion
68d8fa556ae3.plain: Whenever a model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 before it is removed from play. On a 4+, it blows up: every unit within 6" takes 1 mortal wound, apart from NURGLE units.

6982c0b1bb6c.name: Master of the Dead Who Walk (Aura)
6982c0b1bb6c.plain: Aura: while one of your POXWALKERS units is within 6" of this model, attacks made by models in that unit get 1 added to their Strength characteristic.

6c12d968760a.name: Contagion Abilities
6c12d968760a.plain:
Contagion abilities affect enemy models or units within Contagion Range. That range depends on the battle round number and grows as the battle goes on:
- battle round 1: range 1"
- battle round 2: range 3"
- battle round 3: range 6"
- battle round 4: range 9"
Contagion abilities with identical names don't stack: an enemy unit in range of two models that share a Contagion ability is affected by it just once. Although they resemble Aura abilities in many ways, Contagion abilities aren't affected by things that affect Aura abilities, and Aura abilities aren't affected by things that affect Contagion abilities.

6f025e537526.name: Corruption and Decay
6f025e537526.plain: When the Fight phase starts, choose an enemy unit within 3" of one of your GELLERPOX INFECTED units. For the rest of the phase, your GELLERPOX INFECTED models get 1 added to their wound rolls when targeting that enemy unit.

70c3724e31ed.name: Befouled Incubators
70c3724e31ed.plain: During the Fight phase, once a DEATH GUARD CHARACTER model of yours is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, whenever one of its attacks destroys an enemy model, roll a D6. On a 3+, the destroyed model's unit takes 1 mortal wound after your model has finished all its attacks. No more than 3 mortal wounds per phase can be inflicted with this Stratagem.

70e19b0d814b.name: The Lantern
70e19b0d814b.plain: Whenever this weapon's attack scores a hit, trace a straight line from the nearest point of this model's base (or hull) to the nearest point of the closest model in the target unit. Then make one wound roll against the target unit and one against each other unit that the line passes over.

71b92498e784.name: Machine Glitch
71b92498e784.plain: Once a GLITCHLINGS unit of yours has fought in the Fight phase, pick an enemy VEHICLE unit that is within 1" of it, then roll a D6 per model in your unit. Each 4+ inflicts a mortal wound on that enemy unit.

751281099be5.name: Teleport Strike
751281099be5.plain: During deployment, if all of this unit's models have this ability, you may put the unit in a teleportarium chamber instead of placing it on the battlefield. If so, during the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases you may place it on the battlefield anywhere over 9" from every enemy model.

76b1d40fc82e.name: Curse of the Walking Pox
76b1d40fc82e.plain: Whenever a model in this unit makes a melee attack, if an enemy model (other than a VEHICLE or MONSTER model) is destroyed, one of this unit's destroyed models returns to it with 1 wound remaining. Those returned models may be placed within Engagement Range of enemy units, as long as those enemy units are already in Engagement Range of this unit.

7b8485562d08.name: Torrent of Putrefaction
7b8485562d08.plain: Whenever this model successfully manifests a psychic power, look at its Psychic test: if it was 7 or more, D3 mortal wounds are inflicted on the nearest enemy unit within 12"; if it was lower, 1 mortal wound is inflicted on the nearest enemy unit within 6" instead.

7ca2cad0dfb9.name: Belching Fumes
7ca2cad0dfb9.plain: When your opponent's Shooting phase starts, choose a MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULERS unit of yours. For the rest of the phase, when an enemy model attacks that unit with a ranged weapon, that weapon makes 1 fewer attack (but never fewer than 1 in total). Cost: 1CP if the unit has 2 or fewer models, otherwise 2CP.

7f0f4f832dbd.name: Empyric Malaise (Aura)
7f0f4f832dbd.plain: Aura: subtract 1 from Psychic tests taken for enemy PSYKER units while they are within 6" of this model.

83825aa8ac95.name: Break Their Spirits
83825aa8ac95.plain: During the Fight phase, if a DEATH GUARD TERMINATOR model of yours destroys a model from an enemy INFANTRY, BEASTS or SWARM unit: models in that enemy unit have their Leadership characteristic reduced by 4 for the rest of the turn.

83f3371c6657.name: Rancid Vomit
83f3371c6657.plain: In your Shooting phase, pick a HULLBREAKERS model from your army and an enemy unit within 6" of it that it can see. Roll three D6: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers a mortal wound.

8833e3d996b7.name: Master of Destruction (Aura)
8833e3d996b7.plain: Aura: while one of your <PLAGUE COMPANY> CORE units is within 6" of this model, ranged attacks made with a Plague Weapon by models in that unit get their Armour Penetration improved by 1 whenever they roll an unmodified 6 to wound.

88b385fa5eb9.name: Malignant Plaguecaster
88b385fa5eb9.plain: This model knows Smite and 2 psychic powers from the Contagion discipline.

8a2ba89ac44e.name: Blight Racks (Aura)
8a2ba89ac44e.plain: Aura: while one of your BUBONIC ASTARTES units is within 6" of this model, any blight grenades its models carry have Damage 2 and Armour Penetration -1.

8a4ceeaca3b8.name: Manreaper - Scythe
8a4ceeaca3b8.plain: Plague Weapon. For each attack made with this weapon profile, make 2 hit rolls rather than 1.

8bff402f1e13.name: Relaptic Assault
8bff402f1e13.plain: During your opponent's Charge phase, after an enemy unit ends a charge move: choose as many of your MORTARION'S ANVIL units within 3" of that enemy unit as you like. For the rest of the phase, those units may perform Heroic Interventions as though they were CHARACTERS.

8dc65d7b499e.name: Fearsome (Aura)
8dc65d7b499e.plain: Aura: while an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, models in that enemy unit have 1 subtracted from their Leadership characteristic.

90e642f5fb40.name: Gifts of Decay
90e642f5fb40.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the DEATH GUARD keyword: pick one DEATH GUARD CHARACTER model from your army and give it one Relic of Decay (it must be a Relic that model could have). Every Relic in your army must be unique, and this Stratagem can't give one model two Relics. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

924a447745a0.name: Curse of the Leper
924a447745a0.plain: Witchfire: if manifested, pick the closest enemy unit that this PSYKER can see and that is within 18" of it. Roll seven D6s: that unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each result higher than its Toughness characteristic.

9261acbddd51.name: Contagions of Nurgle
9261acbddd51.plain:
If every unit in your army has the DEATH GUARD keyword (not counting UNALIGNED units), this unit gets this ability:

Nurgle's Gift (Contagion): while an enemy unit is within this unit's Contagion Range, models in that enemy unit have 1 subtracted from their Toughness characteristic.

93104f5f38b6.name: Death to the False Emperor
93104f5f38b6.plain: In the Fight phase, each time this model rolls a 6+ to hit while targeting an IMPERIUM unit, it can immediately make an extra attack against that same unit with the same weapon. Extra attacks gained this way can't create more extra attacks.

966c9ab0b25d.name: Mutated Beyond Reason
966c9ab0b25d.plain: The first time this unit is chosen to fight in each Fight phase, roll one D3 and look up the result on this ability's table.

96cb6186dd7c.name: Viscous Death
96cb6186dd7c.plain: When you roll to see how many attacks this weapon makes, you can re-roll that roll.

98130061e3e3.name: Nurgle's Fruit (Contagion)
98130061e3e3.plain: Enemy units within this unit's Contagion Range get no benefit from cover against attacks made by friendly MORTARION'S CHOSEN SONS models.

waive.MORTARION'S CHOSENS SONS: misprint in the official text for the MORTARION'S CHOSEN SONS keyword, which is written correctly here

9a2f7c9d3822.name: Attendant's claws and teeth
9a2f7c9d3822.plain: Plague Weapon. Whenever the bearer fights, it makes D6 extra attacks with this weapon.

9afae9b0d014.name: Magna-melta cannon
9afae9b0d014.plain: Blast. Against a target unit within half range, this weapon's attacks have Damage D6+2.

9bf9603eede3.name: Pernicious Dose
9bf9603eede3.plain: Blessing: if manifested, choose a friendly unit within 6" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, hit rolls for that unit's plague weapon attacks can be re-rolled.

9c8a2b621d63.name: Foul Effluents (Aura)
9c8a2b621d63.plain: Aura: when your Movement phase ends, roll one D6 for every enemy unit within 6" of this WARLORD; a 4+ means that unit takes 1 mortal wound.

9e76f7277003.name: Plague Weapon
9e76f7277003.plain: A weapon with this ability lets you re-roll wound rolls of 1 for its attacks.

a12ad205d6ad.name: Flash Outbreak
a12ad205d6ad.plain:
During your Command phase, choose one of your <PLAGUE COMPANY> units that has the Contagions of Nurgle ability.
- If other <PLAGUE COMPANY> units of yours on the battlefield have Contagion abilities this unit doesn't, it also gains all of those Contagion abilities, alongside its own, until your next Command phase starts.
- Until your next Command phase starts, your units treat the battle round as being one higher than it really is when working out the Contagion range of their Contagion abilities.

a27a83d8f027.name: Lungrot

a3511f3b39c9.name: The Wrathful Dead
a3511f3b39c9.plain: During the Fight phase, once a HARBINGERS POXWALKERS unit is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, hit rolls for its models' attacks can be re-rolled.

a38f80b9716b.name: Pestilential Drop
a38f80b9716b.plain: During the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, when you place a TERMINUS EST ASSAULT FORCE unit of yours on the battlefield using its Outbreak Assault or Teleport Strike ability: choose one of its Contagion of Nurgle abilities. For the rest of the turn, that ability has a Contagion Range of 12" for that unit. This doesn't stack with other abilities that raise Contagion Range.

a4048bfe3f3c.name: Ferric Blight (Contagion)
a4048bfe3f3c.plain: While an enemy unit is within this unit's Contagion Range, each attack by a friendly INEXORABLE model has its Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.

a48b4e3155e8.name: Explodes
a48b4e3155e8.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before it is removed from play. On a 6, it blows up: every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

a4f9ef6ee710.name: Orb of desiccation
a4f9ef6ee710.plain: Blast. Plague Weapon. The bearer can shoot this weapon only once per battle.

a742e042da09.name: Revitalising Malignancy
a742e042da09.plain: When your Movement phase ends, this model may heal a friendly BUBONIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model if that model's unit is within 3" of it, restoring up to D3 of that model's lost wounds. A model can't be healed more than once in a turn.

a9c61e155003.name: Host of the Destroyer Hive
a9c61e155003.plain: During your Command phase, you may roll a D6 for one enemy unit within 6" of this model. On a 2+, D3 mortal wounds are inflicted on that unit.

aa5d727a6c70.name: Rotwind
aa5d727a6c70.plain: Malediction: if manifested, choose an enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, attacks by that unit's models have their Armour Penetration reduced by 2, though it can't go below AP 0 this way.

aa889cbf631d.name: On Droning Wings
aa889cbf631d.plain: In your Command phase, pick one FERRYMEN FOETID VIRION model from your army and one of its aura abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, the range of that aura ability is increased by 6", up to a maximum of 12".

ac9979be255c.name: Eternal Hatred
ac9979be255c.plain: During your Shooting phase when a BUBONIC ASTARTES INFANTRY unit of yours is picked to shoot, or during the Fight phase when one is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, its models' attacks get 1 added to their wound rolls.

aca072382446.name: The Blightening
aca072382446.plain: In your Shooting phase, choose up to three DEATH GUARD models of yours. For the rest of the phase, their plague weapons that have the Grenade type lose the Blast ability and become Pistol 6 weapons. Also, when one of those models uses one of those weapons to attack an enemy unit within Engagement Range, the attack hits the target automatically.

ace0566e1523.name: Rotten Constitution
ace0566e1523.plain: This WARLORD has 1 added to its Toughness characteristic, and attacks with AP -1 or -2 that are allocated to it are treated as AP 0 instead.

ae28849a236e.name: Gellershift
ae28849a236e.plain: Before you move the VOX-SHAMBLERS in the Movement phase: rather than moving as normal, the unit may perform a Gellershift. Take it off the battlefield, and when the Movement phase ends, place it again anywhere over 9" away from every enemy model.

b0570cc2cc06.name: Grandfatherly Influence
b0570cc2cc06.plain:
Before the battle, while mustering your army, pick one DEATH GUARD CHAOS SPAWN unit from your army.
- Its models get 1 added to their Toughness characteristic.
- The unit has the Disgustingly Resilient ability.
This Stratagem costs 1CP if the unit has 3 or fewer models, and 2CP otherwise.

b119a2d1557f.name: Toxic Presence
b119a2d1557f.plain: When working out the Contagion range of its Contagion abilities, this model uses 4 as the battle round number.

b65f8ba9ce7e.name: Explodes
b65f8ba9ce7e.plain: When this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it and before any models embarked in it disembark. On a 6 it explodes: every unit within 6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

b84c407715f2.name: Malicious Volleys

waive.88: page number of the book reference for the bolt weapon definition, not a rule value

b87bac9a3018.name: Death Guard Daemon Prince
b87bac9a3018.plain: This model knows Smite and 1 psychic power from the Contagion discipline.

bb0846634907.name: Arch-Contaminator (Aura)
bb0846634907.plain: Aura: while one of your DEATH GUARD CORE units is within 6" of this WARLORD, its models can re-roll wound rolls for melee attacks with plague weapons. They can also re-roll the wound roll for a ranged attack made with a plague weapon if its target is a unit within 12".

bb2267c252f6.name: Pestilential Fallout
bb2267c252f6.plain: Whenever this model successfully manifests a psychic power with a Psychic test of 7 or more, one mortal wound is inflicted on the nearest enemy unit within 12".

be349321f267.name: Putrid Explosion (1MW)
be349321f267.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before it is removed from play. On a 4+, it blows up: every unit within 6" takes 1 mortal wound, apart from NURGLE units.

be7202781a64.name: Lord of the Death Guard (Aura)
be7202781a64.plain: Aura: while one of your <PLAGUE COMPANY> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

c1cb48fc660a.name: Living Plague (Aura)
c1cb48fc660a.plain: Aura: enemy units within 3" of this WARLORD can't be affected by aura abilities from units in your opponent's army, apart from auras that are psychic powers.

c594a2255dc1.name: Plague-chosen
c594a2255dc1.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the DEATH GUARD keyword: pick one DEATH GUARD CHARACTER model in your army (not a named character) and determine one Warlord Trait for it (it must be one that model can have). That model counts as your WARLORD only for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be unique (re-roll duplicates if you generate them randomly), and this Stratagem can't give one model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

c6f103ee8296.name: Befouling Runoff
c6f103ee8296.plain: The target gets no benefit from cover against attacks made with this weapon.

c85d9d13a7eb.name: Plaguereaper
c85d9d13a7eb.plain: Plague Weapon. Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made with this weapon.

c90d94a979b1.name: Miasma of Pestilence
c90d94a979b1.plain: Blessing: if manifested, choose a friendly DEATH GUARD unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, attacks against that unit have 1 subtracted from their hit rolls.

c9d59fe72dc3.name: The Droning (Contagion)
c9d59fe72dc3.plain: When your opponent's Movement phase starts, halve the Move characteristic of every enemy unit within this unit's Contagion Range, for the rest of that phase.

cb96f91b5ce3.name: Rotting Tide
cb96f91b5ce3.plain: Once per battle, during the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase: choose one of your TERMINUS EST ASSAULT FORCE POXWALKERS units that is below Half-strength and remove it from the battlefield, or choose one of your TERMINUS EST ASSAULT FORCE POXWALKERS units that has been destroyed. Place that unit back at its Starting Strength, wholly within 6" of any battlefield edge apart from the enemy's, and over 9" away from every enemy model. Cost: 2CP if the unit's Starting Strength is 10 models or fewer, otherwise 3CP.

ccf318c3cee3.name: Sickening Vitality (Aura)
ccf318c3cee3.plain: Aura: while one of your <PLAGUE COMPANY> CORE or <PLAGUE COMPANY> FOETID VIRION units is within 6" of this model, whenever that unit is chosen to make a Normal Move or Advance, its models add 1" to their Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

cf2dd5bcd47f.name: Pox Furnace
cf2dd5bcd47f.plain: A Pox Furnace counts as Obstacle Terrain and has these terrain traits from the core rules: Light Cover, Heavy Cover, Unstable Position and Difficult Ground. When a Miasmic Malignifier is destroyed, its Pox Furnace is removed from the battlefield as well.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book", not a rule value

d321c6653752.name: The Seven-fold Chant
d321c6653752.plain: When the Command phase starts, roll 2D6 if this model is on the battlefield. On a 7+, you get 1 Command point.

d97bd6d8385e.name: Noxious Discharge
d97bd6d8385e.plain:
Witchfire: if manifested, pick one enemy unit within 12" of this PSYKER that it can see.
- That unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
- Every unit within 3" of that unit, other than NURGLE units, also suffers 1 mortal wound.

da1dd38ba0c1.name: Malicious Calculation
da1dd38ba0c1.plain: During your Command phase, this model may tally for one <PLAGUE COMPANY> CORE unit of yours that is within 6" of it. Until your next Command phase starts, attacks by that unit's models get 1 added to their hit rolls. A unit can't be tallied for more than once in a turn.

da23433fc089.name: Plague Vector
da23433fc089.plain: The bearer gets the Warlord Trait of its Plague Company. If that trait is Shamblerot, then when you roll to see whether an enemy unit suffers mortal wounds from Shamblerot, that unit suffers only 1 mortal wound on a 6, rather than D3 mortal wounds.

dc2c66178754.name: Foul Infusion
dc2c66178754.plain: Once per turn, when your Charge phase or the Fight phase starts, you may choose a friendly <PLAGUE COMPANY> CORE unit within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, when one of its models makes a melee attack with a Plague Weapon and the unmodified wound roll is a 6, the target also takes 1 mortal wound on top of any normal damage. A unit can't be chosen for this ability more than once in a turn.

dc4a010f4215.name: Explosive Outbreak
dc4a010f4215.plain: For attacks made with this weapon, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit. This doesn't stack with the Tollkeeper ability.

df044b8bef85.name: Plague belcher
df044b8bef85.plain: Plague Weapon. Attacks with this weapon hit their target automatically.

df080c4729e5.name: Virulent Rounds
df080c4729e5.plain: During your Shooting phase, once a DEATH GUARD CORE unit of yours is picked to shoot: for the rest of the phase, any bolt weapons its models carry gain the Plague Weapon ability.

e0f021ff2a5b.name: Mutant Strain

e0f3952b9db1.name: Insane Gibberines
e0f3952b9db1.plain: When the enemy Psychic phase starts: for the rest of the phase, enemy PSYKERS within 18" of VULGRAR THRICE-CURSED have 1 subtracted from their Psychic tests.

e31d2293d65b.name: Outbreak Assault
e31d2293d65b.plain: The rules for Outbreak Assault aren't included in the army data this app uses. They're in The Book of Rust.

e91359e3cde7.name: Fiery Demise
e91359e3cde7.plain: Once VULGRAR THRICE-CURSED is slain, roll a D6 for every unit within 6" before he is removed from the battlefield; each 4+ means that unit takes a mortal wound.

e9438232c5ee.name: Fleshmower
e9438232c5ee.plain: Plague Weapon. For each attack made with this weapon, make 3 hit rolls rather than 1.

eb14094f74f6.name: Release the Toxins
eb14094f74f6.plain: During your Command phase, choose a DEATH GUARD CHARACTER model of yours that carried a Relic of Decay when the battle began. For every enemy unit within 7" of it, roll a D6: a 2-5 means that unit takes 1 mortal wound, and a 6 means it takes D3 mortal wounds. No model can be chosen for this Stratagem more than once per battle.

f1de1894d795.name: Putrid Explosion (D3MW)
f1de1894d795.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before it is removed from play. On a 4+, it blows up: every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds, apart from NURGLE units.

f20ace2a794b.name: Unclean Machine Spirit
f20ace2a794b.plain: During your Command phase, choose a DEATH GUARD MACHINE SPIRIT model of yours. Until your next Command phase starts, it counts as having all its wounds left when you work out which characteristics on its profile apply.

f287120bb461.name: Gift of Infection
f287120bb461.plain: Malediction: if manifested, choose an enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, that unit's models have 1 subtracted from their Toughness characteristic. This doesn't stack with Toughness penalties caused by any Contagion of Nurgle abilities.

f40203926274.name: Gift of Plagues
f40203926274.plain: Blessing: if manifested, choose a friendly DEATH GUARD unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, every Contagion ability that unit has gets 6" added to its range, but no more than 12" in total.

f40bb2d61c5a.name: Bile spurt
f40bb2d61c5a.plain: Blast. Plague Weapon. The bearer can use this weapon to attack an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit.

f43277a16a0d.name: Hateful Assault
f43277a16a0d.plain: If this unit makes a charge move, gets charged, or performs a Heroic Intervention, its models have 1 added to their Attacks characteristic until the end of the turn.

f61020d911aa.name: Overwhelming Generosity
f61020d911aa.plain: During your Shooting phase, once a DEATH GUARD unit of yours is picked to shoot: for the rest of the phase, any plague weapons its models carry have their Range characteristic increased by 6".

f80eae8ec6b6.name: Foetid wings
f80eae8ec6b6.plain: The bearer has the FLY keyword and a Move characteristic of 10".

f91305890143.name: Arch-Contaminator (Aura)
f91305890143.plain: Aura: while one of your <PLAGUE COMPANY> CORE units is within 6" of this WARLORD, its models can re-roll wound rolls for melee attacks with plague weapons. They can also re-roll the wound roll for a ranged attack made with a plague weapon if its target is a unit within 12".

face3d6516f7.name: Primarch of the Death Guard
face3d6516f7.plain: During your Command phase, choose a DEATH GUARD CORE or DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit of yours that is within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, hit rolls for attacks by that unit's models can be re-rolled.

fb091aa4cada.name: Inexorable Advance
fb091aa4cada.plain:
- Unless this unit Fell Back or Advanced in your previous Movement phase, it counts as having Remained Stationary.
- If this is a VEHICLE unit, it doesn't take the hit roll penalty for shooting Heavy weapons at enemy units within its Engagement Range.
- If this is an INFANTRY unit, it can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic, its Advance rolls and its charge rolls.

fe1af2420b0f.name: Unstable Sickness
fe1af2420b0f.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon destroys one or more enemy models, roll one D6. On a 4+, the destroyed model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound. No more than 3 mortal wounds can be inflicted this way per turn. The bearer can't be chosen for the Befouled Incubators Stratagem.

ff7cd9c6aaf3.name: Manreaper - Cleave
ff7cd9c6aaf3.plain: Plague Weapon. Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made with this weapon profile.
